title: Split, Unlearn, Merge: Leveraging Data Attributes for More Effective Unlearning in LLMs
findings: The proposed SPUNGE framework, when combined with existing unlearning methods like TVN and RMU, significantly reduces the generation of toxic content targeted at Muslims. The toxicity percentage for the 'Muslim' demographic group was shown to decrease after applying the SPUNGE-enhanced unlearning methods.
